description: Interface between a MIDI to CV module and the rack: it taps the MIDI clock for a BPM voltage, follows the transport, and works out latency corrected timing for sixteen destinations

params.text: Selects which of the sixteen channels the latency knob edits, 1 to 16
Sets the latency correction for the selected channel, -100ms to 100ms

inputs.text: The divided MIDI clock, used to line the local clock up with the MIDI clock
The MIDI clock at 24 pulses per beat, tapped to work out the tempo
A MIDI start message here sets the module running from the beginning
A MIDI stop message here takes the module out of the running state
A MIDI continue message here sets the module running without restarting
The reference timing threshold to be corrected, taken from the CMP output of Swing

outputs.text: The tempo worked out from the MIDI clock, as a volt per octave BPM voltage
A reset trigger sent when a start message arrives
Held high for as long as the transport is running
Polyphonic timing thresholds, one channel per latency setting, for Gator instances to produce latency corrected gates

notes: nothing is worked out until a MIDI to CV module is patched in: CLK takes the MIDI clock at 24 pulses per beat, and START, STOP and CONT take the transport messages
